newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Capex started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Capex started as hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it had started coverage of Argentine thermoelectric power generating company Capex SA with a recommendation of hold.

-- "Although transmission difficulties from Capex's facilities to the Buenos Aires area hamper near-term earnings growth and expansion prospects, the company enjoys a favorable competitive position relative to other Argentine thermoelectric power producers," analyst Gilberto Casillas wrote in a November 19 report.

-- "Electricity pricing within the Argentine market remains very competitive; as such, we believe that sales of the company's principal product will be marginally less profitable going forward," he wrote.
-- "Largely as a result of low pricing, we find that the shares of Capex are fully valued, and thus initiate coverage of the shares with a hold rating."
